articles.summary: Bees need farms. Farms need bees. And our food system needs both.When you picture a bee, you might picture a backyard garden, a wildflower meadow or a honey hive.But some of the most important places for pollinators are working farms.Pollinators play an important role in agricultural ecosystems, helping support the plants and crops that make up our food system.
